text: Program Description (1)Grade One (1st semester) New students should pass the Entrance Examination of Grade One (1st semester); Grade One (2nd semester) A:Students who join in Grade One (2nd semester) should : ①offer the certificate and transcript of one semester’s studying (20 credits) provided by a university or a college; ②offer the certificate and transcript of HSK (NEW) Level 4 (score over 180); ③pass the Entrance Examination of Grade One (2nd semester); B:Audit students of Grade One (2nd semester) should: ①offer the certificate and transcript of one semester’s studying (20 credits) provided by a university or a college; ②pass the Entrance Examination of Grade One (2nd semester). Memo: The audit period is one year and the audit students should get the certificate and transcript of HSK(NEW) Level 4 (score over 210) within one year, otherwise they are not qualified to go up to Grade Two. (2)Grade Two (1st semester) A:New students should: ①offer the certificate and transcript of two semesters’ studying (40 credits) provided by a university or a college; ②offer the certificate and transcript of HSK (NEW) Level 4 (score over 210); ③ pass the Entrance Examination of Grade Two (1st semester); B:Audit students of Grade Two (1st semester) should: ①offer the certificate and transcript of two semesters’ studying (40 credits) provided by a university or a college; ②offer the certificate and transcript of HSK (NEW) Level 4 (score over 195); ③pass the Entrance Examination of Grade Two (1st semester); Grade Two(2nd semester) A:New students should: ①offer the certificate and transcript of three semesters’ studying (60 credits) provided by a university or a college; ②offer the certificate and transcript of HSK (NEW) Level 4 (score over 210); ③pass the Entrance Examination of Grade Two (2nd semester); B:Audit students of Grade Two (2nd semester) should: ①offer the certificate and transcript of three semesters’ studying (60 credits) provided by a university or a college; ②offer the certificate and transcript of HSK (NEW) Level 4 (score over 195); ③pass the Entrance Examination of Grade Two (2nd semester). (3)Grade Three (1st semester) A:New students should: ①offer the certificate and transcript of four semesters’ studying (80 credits) provided by a university or a college; ②offer the certificate and transcript of HSK (NEW) Level 5 (score over 180); ③pass the Entrance Examination of Grade Three (1st semester); B:Audit students of Grade Three (1st semester) should: ①offer the certificate and transcript of four semesters’ studying (80 credits) provided by a university or a college; ②offer the certificate and transcript of HSK (NEW) Level 4 (score over 210); ③pass the Entrance Examination of Grade Three (1st semester).
